newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ registered unemployment down slightly in Sept.
newsitem.headline: NZ registered unemployment down slightly in Sept.

text.p: The number of New Zealanders registered as unemployed fell slightly in September to 154,133, a fall of 195 or 0.1 percent since August, Employment Minister Wyatt Creech said on Thursday.

Creech said it was encouraging that Maori and long-term unemployment were continuing to fall. More women appeared to be looking for work, probably in response to advertising and budget measures making part-time work more attractive.
Long-term unemployment (those registered for 26 weeks or longer) has fallen to 40.7 percent of the total registered from 44.1 percent a year ago.

The figures show only people who have chosen to enrol with the Employment Service. The official measure of unemployment is Statistics New Zealand's Household Labour Force Survey which recorded an unemployment rate of 6.1 percent at June 30.
